caption_L1: Here a line chart is labeled Percentage of households with central heating systems in the United Kingdom (UK) from 1970 to 2018. The y-axis shows Percentage of respondents along a linear scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 1.0. Response is shown on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: Since 1970 the proportion of households in the UK with central heating systems has increased 3 fold. Fast acceleration of uptake between 1970 and 1990 moved the country from 30% to 80% of households having central heating. The growth rate then slowed between 1990 and 2010, with circa 97% of hourseholds having central heating by 2010.
